# Expected results

Expected semantic properties are stored in `../manifest.json` so the small
corpus has one machine-readable source of truth. S2-T01 through S2-T04 tests use
the text-free `ParsedDocumentCanonicalProjection` to prove repeat and parallel
determinism for parsed structure, effective formatting, numbering semantics,
heading evidence, outline structure, semantic sections, observed systematics,
and provenance without persisting paragraph or abstract content in snapshots.
